## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-reviewed the code
- [ ] No new warnings introduced
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] State and `Task` ownership are explicit; cancellation and stale completion were considered
- [ ] Errors are classified and surfaced; no meaningful failure is swallowed
- [ ] Logs and telemetry contain no public path, filename, URL, prompt, token, or identifier
- [ ] No new `@unchecked Sendable` or warning suppression was added to bypass concurrency checks
- [ ] User-visible behavior has a regression test or a documented manual verification
